name: 陳煒朋
objective:
本課程旨在探究投資者如何安排與管理各類金融資產，透過本課程期使學生瞭解投資基本理論、投資工具與運用、投資分析與策略、金融證券市場實務操作以及投資未來的新趨勢，給予學生正確的投資觀念。課程內容包括投資學背景架構、報酬與投資組合理論等等。站在投資者的角度，結合投資理論與學術實證結果之討論，將投資的基本理論與觀念，讓學生理解在市場與投資決策上之實用性，並培養獨立思考與辯證能力。
This course is to interpret the economic analysis and evaluation of investment. The main topics include investment models, investment criteria, investment risk analysis, investment decision under uncertainty.
schedule:
1. Class overview 
2. Risk, return, and the historical record
3. The uses and calculation of the market index
4. Capital allocation to risky assets
5. Optimal risky portfolios
6. Index models and Performance measure approaches for selecting the optimum portfolio
7. Capital asset pricing model
8. Asset allocation
9. 期中考試 / 作業
10. Arbitrage pricing theory and multifactor models for risk and return
11. Portfolio performance evaluation
12. The efficient market hypothesis
13. Behavioral finance and technical analysis
14. International diversification
15. Passive portfolio management
16. Active portfolio management
17. Mutual funds and ETFs
18. 期末報告
scorePolicy:
